answer_1.quote: We propose ReCode, a Robustness Evaluation framework for Code, aiming to provide comprehensive assessment for robustness of code generation models ... code generation tasks ... HumanEval and MBPP datasets ...

answer_2.quote: Pass@k is a widely used metric for measuring the performance of code generation tasks. We extend its definition to Robust Pass@k ... We also report CodeBLEU (syntax) and CodeBLEU (dataflow) scores as automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation. To verify the naturalness of the perturbations in ReCode, we randomly sample and shuffle ... each sample is shown to 5 human annotators ... they are asked to rate naturalness and semantics.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each perturbed sample on naturalness (0, 0.5, 1) and semantic similarity (0, 0.5, 1).
